reviews.reason: Truthfully captures the maturation from instructions toward scripts as progressively reducing interpretive and execution freedom; omitted intermediate layers are permissible.
Accurately identifies the four enforcement layers and the two dimensions they progressively constrain.
Faithfully states the constraining gradient and its supported flexibility-for-reliability tradeoff.
Accurately distinguishes warning hooks’ deterministic triggers and LLM-mediated responses from fully deterministic blocking hooks and scripts.
Faithfully adds the artifact’s progressive-compilation conclusion that proven, sufficiently stable practices can be codified.
